# xyops_event (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xyops_event" "hello_event" {
  title    = "Hello Event"
  enabled  = true
  category = "general"
  plugin   = "shellplug"
  targets  = ["local"]
  algo     = "random"
  notes    = "Managed by Terraform"
  params   = jsonencode({ script = "#!/bin/sh\necho hello" })
  fields   = jsonencode([])
  triggers = jsonencode([])
  limits   = jsonencode([])
  actions  = jsonencode([])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String)
- `plugin` (String)
- `targets` (List of String)
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `actions` (String)
- `algo` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `fields` (String)
- `limits` (String)
- `notes` (String)
- `params` (String)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `triggers` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xyops_event.hello_event hello_event
```
